# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-10 from the 2026-11-10 Hub dump.

- 3,225,912 models tracked, 924,962 declare a base model, 958,259 parent links, 91,652 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
